package.name: wojtek_deck
package.description: The deck panel: a browser cockpit for a handheld (a Steam Deck, a phone, a laptop) joined to the robot's wifi, and the robot-side gateway it talks to. One process on the robot serves the page, carries the drive commands over a websocket with the dead-man on THIS side of the wifi link, and streams the colour camera as MJPEG. Telemetry for the charts does not pass through here: the page reads it straight from foxglove_bridge. Runs on the RPi (no GUI deps) and in the simulation.
